description: This file defines a configuration class for VolcEngine's chat API, extending a base OpenAI-like chat configuration. It includes parameters specific to VolcEngine and methods for parameter mapping and retrieval.

classes.name: VolcEngineChatConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for VolcEngine chat models, extending OpenAILikeChatConfig with additional parameters and methods for parameter handling.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the configuration object, setting attributes based on provided parameters.

methods.name: get_config
methods.description: Returns the configuration dictionary from the superclass.

methods.name: get_supported_openai_params
methods.description: Returns a list of supported OpenAI-like parameters for the model.

methods.name: map_openai_params
methods.description: Maps and processes OpenAI parameters, handling special 'thinking' parameter logic for VolcEngine models.
